name: Insight Lifetech Co., Ltd.
summary: Insight Lifetech Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sales of interventional medical devices in the field of precision diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases in China and internationally. The company provides Coronary intervention products, including precision and complex percutaneous coronary intervention products, such as intracavitary imaging and physiological function products; peripheral vascular interventional diagnostic and treatment products; and electrophysiological products.
